systems.system: AFIS (Système automatisé de reconnaissance d'empreintes digitales)
systems.owner: INTERPOL project under the SIPAO programme, EU-funded at EUR 5 million over 33 months (2022-2024)
systems.tiers: Benin named with Gambia and Togo as the three pilot countries for a complete AFIS, recommended by the project steering committee on 21 July 2022; launch missions to the pilot countries in September-October 2022

systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.owner: INTERPOL programme, EU-funded since 2012 (EUR 52 million cumulative), with the ECOWAS Commission
systems.tiers: stated for the region only, not for Benin: 14 of 16 beneficiary countries have an operational data centre (DACORE) that collects, centralises and records police data daily; extension beyond the DACORE in the capital is a 2023 priority

systems.system: plateforme régionale de partage de données SIPAO
systems.tiers: regional; decentralised platform kept for a transitional period by the experts' committee of 8-9 November 2022

note: No fact: Benin appears only as an AFIS pilot country, a noted class. What the newsletter says of SIPAO is regional and names no Benin site; it describes central data centres recording police data, not stations entering their reports or cases.
